title.en: What the Oxy–fuel welding and cutting outline cannot add to concrete pump split piston φ220
title.zh: 《Oxy–燃料焊接与 切割》的大纲不能给concrete pump split piston φ220加数字

description.en: Section titles come from Oxy–fuel welding and cutting; the concrete pump split piston φ220 figures stay the printed ones. A φ220 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are polyurethane only. No published pump page assigns φ220 to a model.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Oxy–燃料焊接与 切割》，concrete pump split piston φ220的数字仍是已印数字。φ220 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ220 指定到某一型号。

h1.en: Oxy–fuel welding and cutting headings over the concrete pump split piston φ220 catalogue line
h1.zh: 《Oxy–燃料焊接与 切割》的标题盖在concrete pump split piston φ220的目录行上

directAnswer.en: The short answer for concrete pump split piston φ220 uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Oxy–fuel welding and cutting is the outline those cells are filed under. A φ220 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are polyurethane only. No published pump page assigns φ220 to a model.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump split piston φ220的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《Oxy–燃料焊接与 切割》是这些格子所依的大纲。 φ220 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ220 指定到某一型号。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Uses” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. The split piston is a replacement set for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied from Xingtai by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. The full outer-diameter list is φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. This note is only the φ220 row, materials: polyurethane only. Unit: set. The page does not print a compound grade, a hardness, or a service life. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The integral-piston page is a different part. Where the same φ220 also appears there, it is still not a pump-model assignment. Electric 20's 80 mm figure is a pipe inner diameter, not a piston outer diameter. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “用途”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 分体活塞是河北品锦机械从邢台供应的 S 阀混凝土泵替换套件。全部外径是 φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。本文只写 φ220 这一行，材料：只有聚氨酯。单位：套。页面没有印胶料牌号、硬度或寿命。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 整体活塞是另一件配件。若同一个 φ220 也出现在那边，仍然不是泵型号的指定。电动20的 80 mm 是输送管内径，不是活塞外径。 标题到此为止。

body.en: “Apparatus” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ220, the material row (polyurethane only), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “装置”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ220、材料行（只有聚氨酯）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Read “Fuels” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. A φ220 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are polyurethane only. No published pump page assigns φ220 to a model. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 把“来源章节：Fuels”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 φ220 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ220 指定到某一型号。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Read “Operating costs” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 把“来源章节：Operating costs”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Types of flame”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“来源章节：Types of flame”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Use “Safety” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 分体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oxy%E2%80%93fuel_welding_and_cutting
body.zh: 用“安全性”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明分体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oxy%E2%80%93fuel_welding_and_cutting
